title: GTA6 Launch Date Confirmed: November 19, 2026
summary: Rockstar and Take-Two have reconfirmed the release date twice in 2026 — once when pre-orders opened in June, and again during the August Extended Look gameplay reveal. Grand Theft Auto VI launches November 19, 2026 on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S.

title: No PC Version at Launch — Console Only
summary: Rockstar has confirmed only PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S for the November 19 launch, with no PC storefront, digital platform, or system requirements announced. Based on the GTA5 and Red Dead Redemption 2 patterns, a PC release realistically lands sometime in late 2027 to 2028.

title: Welcome to Leonida: The World of GTA6
summary: GTA6 is set in the fictional state of Leonida, a Florida-inspired sprawl anchored by Vice City. Trailers so far have shown swampland, beaches, and a dense urban core, continuing the series' tradition of a satirical, real-world-adjacent setting.

title: Meet Jason and Lucia — GTA6's Protagonists
summary: Rockstar confirmed a pair of protagonists, Jason and Lucia, in the very first trailer — a first for the mainline series. The August Extended Look expanded on their dynamic and the Bonnie-and-Clyde framing of the story.
